prompts.01_노을실루엣: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting: confident black ink outlines, textured acrylic brushstrokes. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere. Scene: dusk at a Joseon village. A huge blazing orange, red and gold sunset sky with layered stylized gray clouds fills the frame. In the foreground a greedy rich man in a gat hat sneaks toward a storehouse, drawn as a pure solid black silhouette, beside black pine tree silhouettes and a thatched roof silhouette. Strong complementary contrast of orange sky and deep blue-violet shadows.
